pages.text: Place an upgrade block directly against a free face of the quarry. The Upgrade Base is used in crafting. Leave room for the marker, FE, and the output inventory.

pages.title: Silk Touch
pages.text: The Silk Touch Upgrade preserves eligible blocks and multiplies quarry power draw by five.$(br2)Make it in the $(l:extrautilitiesrebirth:machines/enchanter#quarry_upgrades)Enchanter$(/l) from a Quarry Upgrade Base and a Silk Touch reagent.
Leaves the excavation open. It also doubles the power draw and reduces the speed setting.

pages.title: Speed II
pages.text: Speed II adds four to the speed setting and triples the base power draw.$(br2)Make it in the $(l:extrautilitiesrebirth:machines/enchanter#quarry_upgrades)Enchanter$(/l) from Speed I and an Efficiency III or higher reagent.

pages.title: Speed III
pages.text: Speed III adds eight to the speed setting and multiplies the base power draw by five.$(br2)Make it in the $(l:extrautilitiesrebirth:machines/enchanter#quarry_upgrades)Enchanter$(/l) from Speed II and an Efficiency V reagent.

pages.title: Speed I
pages.text: Speed I raises the speed setting by two and doubles the base power draw. Faster work can also increase the number of steps attempted per tick.$(br2)$(l:extrautilitiesrebirth:mining/ender_quarry)Check your quarry$(/l) for power or blocked output after adding upgrades.
